name: DNS Failure - Broken resolv.conf
expected_symptoms: Logs show 'DNS failed' or 'nslookup: can't resolve google.com'
root_cause: An initContainer is overwriting /etc/resolv.conf with a non-functional nameserver (1.2.3.4).
fix_steps: Remove the initContainer and the /etc/resolv.conf volume mount to allow the default K8s DNS to work.
confirm_commands: kubectl exec -it $(kubectl get pod -l app=dns-fail -n oncall-bench -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -n oncall-bench -- cat /etc/resolv.conf
